scope: All public tools registered in data/tool-contracts.json

requiredPageSignals.canonical: Every tool page must expose one canonical URL.
requiredPageSignals.purpose: The page must state what the tool does.
requiredPageSignals.methodBoundary: The page must state what the result cannot establish.
requiredPageSignals.privacy: The page must state where user inputs are processed and whether any data leaves the browser.
requiredPageSignals.evidence: The page must identify the evidence source or first-party method basis.
requiredPageSignals.maturity: The page or registry must expose a governed maturity status.
requiredPageSignals.version: Computational tools must expose a semantic method version; living resources must expose a YYYY-MM snapshot tied to their ISO review date.
requiredPageSignals.export: Any export must be local, inspectable and must not imply certification. A tool without export remains conformant when its outputs are reproducible or printable.

privacyRules: No private research data is collected by Gurjas.
Third-party requests occur only after a disclosed user action.
Recipients and transmitted fields are named in the tool contract.
No account is required for a public tool.
claimRules: No tool may guarantee acceptance, publication, accreditation, legitimacy, eligibility or payment safety.
Scores and labels must be bounded by disclosed evidence and method limitations.
Database absence must not be presented as proof of misconduct or illegitimacy.
